name: St. Louis
registryBasis: The City of St. Louis Assessor’s Records and Mapping section says it records real-property transfers and maintains assessment plat maps of all parcels. The official city data page publishes a weekly-updated current-parcels shapefile with key field HANDLE; the City also lists an interactive parcel map and an ArcGIS service. This is a city assessment/parcel-mapping source, not verified title or legal-survey geometry.
scopeLimits: City-specific source discovery only. No full polygon sample is retained. Citywide/countrywide completeness, title identity, legal survey accuracy, exact WUP point coverage and runtime suitability are not asserted. No owner, address, account/tax identifier, credentials, or token values were requested or retained.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: Layer metadata exposes property-record attributes, so the bounded query allowlisted OBJECTID only plus geometry. The official REST query timed out after 15 seconds. The official downloadable current-parcels file is a whole-city shapefile and was not fetched; no full geometry sample is verified.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the public REST service is available for bounded reads and whether the assessment Lots layer matches legal parcel units or the WUP point remain unverified.
nextStep: No runtime qualification was attempted. If further review is needed, use only a bounded source-native geometry query with an allowlisted non-sensitive identifier and geometry.
